name: Optimal "where" on Tenstorrent
description: Deep-dive into implementing the where(condition, t, f, out) kernel on the Tenstorrent Wormhole vector unit. Achieves optimal throughput of 3 cycles/row (in-place) and 4 cycles/row (out-of-place) by cycle-counting assembly on the 32-lane SFPU.
author: jasondavies
